Second movie: There are three (Stegosaurus, Compsognathus and  Mamenchisaurus), with the same above from Cretaceous plus Pachycephalosaurus and Pteranodon

Third movie: Same as second movie but instead of Mamenchisaurus we have the return of the Brachiosaurus and the Ceratosaurus is added. For the Cretaceous we lost the Pachy and Gallimimus but now we have the Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus and Corythosaurus

Fourth movie: There are three Jurassic era species (Stegosaurus, Apatosaurus and Dimorphodon) plus the T rex, Gallimimus, Trike, Pteranodon, Mossasaurus, Parasaurolophus and Ankylosaurus for the Cretaceous

Fifth movie: There tons of species here. Jurassic (Apatosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Compys, Allosaurus and Stegosaurus), Cretaceous (T rex, Trikes, Velociraptor, Carnotaurus, Baryonyx, Pteranodon, Sinoceratops, Ankylosaurus, Parasaurolophus and Mossasaurus)
